1500.author: yuanzhou75
1500.body:
## What this fixes

The rail paints `apps/desktop/src/assets/brand/app-mark.png` at 32x32 on a `#f5f5f5` surface. Since `6614a0c4` ("switch logo, app mark and Windows icon to the rounded light variant") that PNG fills its whole 128x128 canvas with a white rounded square - 94.6% of its pixels are opaque and 65% of them are pure white - so the rail shows a white tile with the mark inside it instead of the mark itself.

This replaces the asset with the transparent cut of the same official artwork, and corrects the stylesheet comment that described a tile.

## How the asset was made

- Source: the official vertical light logo, rendered at 8x on a transparent page.
- The wordmark is everything below the fully transparent band at y=471-564 of that render; the mark above it is 320x372 px there.
- Crop: a square canvas around the mark with 6% breathing room, resized to 128x128 with Lanczos, RGBA. Corners and the hollow middle are fully transparent (60.4% of the canvas is empty).
- The file keeps the 128 px size the stylesheet asks for, so `background-size: 32px 32px` and `border-radius: 8px` are untouched.

## Surfaces that paint this file

| surface | rule | background |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rail | `apps/desktop/src/styles/design.css:90` | `#f5f5f5` |
| wizard header | `apps/desktop/src/styles/wizard.css:63` | `#fff` |
| sign-in header | `apps/desktop/src/styles/login.css:40` | `#fff` |
| skill import marks | `apps/desktop/src/styles/settings.css:1811` | `#fff` |

All four are light, so the transparent cut works on each without a code change.

## Frames

Pinned to commit `94581e69` on `yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery:screenshots-appmark`, not to a branch name. Harness: `apps/desktop/e2e` - Vite on its own port, `fixtures.ts` answers every `/api/**` request; viewport 1280x820, DPR 1, zh-CN. The only difference between a "before" and its "after" is `app-mark.png`.

![rail mark, before and after, 2x](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/94581e6985ece3df842c11792742707cc09893af/shots/app-mark/before-after-rail-2x.png)

| frame | what it shows |
| --- | --- |
| [before-rail-160.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/94581e6985ece3df842c11792742707cc09893af/shots/app-mark/before-rail-160.png) | the rail's top-left corner as shipped: white rounded tile, 32 px |
| [after-rail-160.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/94581e6985ece3df842c11792742707cc09893af/shots/app-mark/after-rail-160.png) | the same corner with this head: the mark on `#f5f5f5`, no tile |
| [before-window-1280.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/94581e6985ece3df842c11792742707cc09893af/shots/app-mark/before-window-1280.png) | the whole 1280x820 window before |
| [after-window-1280.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/94581e6985ece3df842c11792742707cc09893af/shots/app-mark/after-window-1280.png) | the whole 1280x820 window after |

The two window frames are labelled zh-CN, but nothing in this change carries copy: the same asset paints in every language, so a second locale would show the same pixels.

`raw.githubusercontent.com` did not answer from this machine while I was writing this, so each of the five files was checked through the contents API at commit `94581e69` instead: every remote size equals the local byte count exactly.

## Not changed on purpose

- `docs/images/logo.png` (320x320, the source `application/scripts/make-icon.ps1` derives the installer icons from) and `application/build/icon-256.png`, `icon.ico`, `icon.icns` keep their tile. An OS icon is shown against unknown desktop backgrounds, and a transparent one would disappear on a dark taskbar.
- `border-radius: 8px` on `.rail-logo` stays: it has no visible effect on a transparent asset and keeps the rule correct if a filled asset is ever used again.

## Testing

- No behaviour changed: one binary asset, one comment. No unit test asserts the pixels of the mark and I did not add one - a jsdom test cannot read the PNG's alpha without a decoder dependency, and the frames above are what a person can actually check.
- `L1`, `UT` and `ST` do not read this asset; the CSS edit is inside a comment, so none of them can move.
- The capture spec that produced the frames is a throw-away in the desktop harness and is not part of this diff.

1500.title: fix(desktop): draw the rail mark without the white tile
